scene zero · the sky · a familiar place

Perplexity
Explorer

DistilGPT-2 reads your sentence one token at a time and quietly bets on each next word. Perplexity is how surprised it was, on average — low means the dream found your sentence familiar, high means it has never seen this place before. The model runs entirely in your browser. Keep sliding sideways: the dream is a corridor, not a page — and every room in it is a different size inside than out.
